title: Verified upstream
current: Upstream freshness reattaches a detached primary checkout to the declared base branch before fast-forwarding only when the checkout is clean and HEAD equals that branch's local tip. Its files and branch then advance together. A dirty primary checkout or one detached at another commit stays unchanged and reports behind_not_updated with the detached revision and the git switch recovery command. Linked worktrees keep their detached HEAD; a base branch held in another worktree remains untouched.
